issues.problem: The rule `#ui .menus, #ui .menu, #ui button { pointer-events: auto; }` (line 21) turns the full-screen #menus container into an invisible click-catcher above the canvas, even when every menu screen is hidden. Input only listens for mousedown on the canvas. So whenever pointer lock is NOT held, no mouse button reaches the game: the rifle (LMB), blade (RMB) and lock switch (MMB) do nothing, clicking the screen never re-captures the mouse, and the documented drag-look fallback cannot work. While pointer lock is held (the normal LAUNCH-click path) the problem is hidden, because locked mouse events go straight to the canvas.
issues.repro: Executed on dist/ironwake.html?test=1, start a mission: document.elementFromPoint(screen centre) returns #menus, computed pointer-events is 'auto'. A real Playwright mouse down/up at the centre gives 0 canvas mousedowns and 0 shots. In drag-look mode (input.dragLook=true) a held drag gives 0 shots and no aim change. With an injected `#ui .menus{pointer-events:none}`: the canvas gets the mousedown, the rifle fires 2 rounds, the drag turns aim by 0.187 rad, and pause -> RESUME is still clickable (probe.mjs, probe2.mjs). Likely real-user trigger (Chrome's lock policy cannot be reproduced headless): Esc to pause, Esc again to resume. The relock request comes from a key event without a user gesture (or within Chrome's ~1 s re-lock cooldown), so it is refused, and from then on the mouse can neither aim nor fire until the player pauses and clicks RESUME. Same in any iframe or browser that denies pointer lock.
issues.fix: In css/main.css line 21 drop `#ui .menus`: use `#ui .menu, #ui button { pointer-events: auto; }` so the hidden container stays click-through (ui.css already declares `.menus { pointer-events: none }`). Harden input.js `_onMouseButton` so a canvas mousedown retries requestPointerLock while playing even when dragLook is on (skip only for a sandboxed iframe). Add a HUD hint 'CLICK TO AIM / クリックで照準操作' while state==='playing' && !pointerLocked. Add a smoke assertion: during play, elementFromPoint(centre) === canvas, and with dragLook on a real mouse drag fires the rifle and changes aimYaw.

issues.problem: dist/ironwake.html, the only file the end user can play, is ignored by `.gitignore` line 6 (`dist/`) and has never been committed (`git log -- ironwake/dist/ironwake.html` is empty, `git ls-files ironwake/dist` is empty). README_JA step 1 tells the user to double-click dist/ironwake.html. A repository download or clone therefore contains no playable file, and the user cannot run npm to build one.
issues.repro: git -C /home/user/Kuchiwan ls-files ironwake/dist -> nothing. git check-ignore -v ironwake/dist/ironwake.html -> ironwake/.gitignore:6:dist/.
issues.fix: At release (orchestrator), run `npm run build && git add -f ironwake/dist/ironwake.html`, as the .gitignore comment says, or replace `dist/` with `dist/*` plus `!dist/ironwake.html`. Then confirm with `git ls-files ironwake/dist` and that the file is under 16 MB (it is 12.09 MB today).

issues.problem: Key, mouse and pad presses set `latch[]` even while input is disabled (lines 116, 134 and 224). Gameplay keys pressed in the pause menu therefore all fire on the first step after resume. This wastes finite resources: missiles, cannon rounds, and repair kits, which also cost 7 rank points each.
issues.repro: Executed (probe5.mjs / edge.mjs): play -> Esc -> press Q, Space, R in the pause menu -> Esc. On resume, 5 missiles launch, the rig jumps 8.8 m, and 1 repair kit is consumed. With the fix below: 0 / 0 m / 0.
issues.fix: Clear edge state whenever play resumes: in Game.setState when next==='playing', run `this.input.latch.fill(0); this.input.lookAccum.x = this.input.lookAccum.y = 0;`. Alternatively, in _onKey / _onMouseButton / pollGamepad, only latch when `this.enabled`, and keep emitting input:action for the menus.

issues.problem: OPTIONS -> GRAPHICS QUALITY only calls pipeline.setQuality, which changes post effects only. The shadow cascade sizes and the far cascade (environment.js QUALITY, read once at boot), the ash/weather particle counts (arena.js:250, weather) and the pixel ratio are fixed at boot from the URL or auto-detect. README_JA's advice ('動きが重いときは LOW') is therefore only partly effective on weak GPUs.
issues.repro: Code-verified: environment.js computes `Q = QUALITY[game.params.quality]` once in the factory and exposes no setQuality; menus.applyOptions only calls game.pipeline.setQuality. The 7x OPTIONS cycle (misc.mjs) changed only the post-chain textures (78/86). The frame-time impact was not measured (no GPU).
issues.fix: Add env.setQuality(name), which resizes the near shadow map, enables or disables the far cascade, and calls rebakeFarShadow, plus a weather/ash count update. Call it from menus.applyOptions, or simply reload with `?quality=` after the option changes, with a short 'applies after restart / 再起動後に反映' note.

issues.problem: There is no auto-pause on window blur or tab hide. Only pointer-lock loss pauses the game, so when the mouse is not captured (keyboard play, after the A-level mouse issue, drag-look) alt-tabbing leaves the sim running and enemies keep shooting.
issues.repro: Executed (misc.mjs): in live mode, dispatch a window 'blur' while playing -> state stays 'playing' and the sim keeps stepping.
issues.fix: In Game.init, add window 'blur' and document 'visibilitychange' (hidden) listeners: `if (this.state==='playing') this.setState('paused')`.

issues.problem: Menus cannot be navigated with a gamepad. PAD_BINDINGS has no D-pad (buttons 12-15), and stick axes never emit input:action. Only A (confirm the highlighted item) and START work, so OPTIONS and RETURN TO TITLE are unreachable with a pad. The menus.js header comment ('d-pad/stick via the same actions') is false.
issues.repro: Code-verified: pollGamepad emits input:action only for bound buttons 0-11, and menus._onAction needs move_forward/back or look_up/down to change the selection. (The fake-pad test confirmed stick, RT, right stick and START work in game.)
issues.fix: In pollGamepad, when !this.enabled, emit menu actions for D-pad 12/13 ('look_up'/'look_down'), 14/15 ('look_left'/'look_right') and for a left-stick edge past 0.6, plus B (Pad1) as 'pause' = back. Keep these out of the in-game latch.

issues.problem: Below about 12 fps the game runs in slow motion instead of keeping real time: realDt is clamped to 0.1 and MAX_STEPS_PER_FRAME is 5. At 8 fps the sim advanced 2.67 s per 4 s of wall time (67% speed). README_JA says GPU-less PCs 'work but are heavy'; on such PCs the whole mission plays slowed.
issues.repro: Executed: synthetic RAF timestamps through Game._loop: 60/30/15 fps -> 239/240/239 steps and identical distance; 8 fps -> 160 steps.
issues.fix: Acceptable by design. Optionally raise MAX_STEPS_PER_FRAME to 8, and/or show a one-time 'LOW PERFORMANCE: set GRAPHICS QUALITY to LOW / 画質をLOWに' callout when the measured fps stays under 20 for 5 s.

issues.problem: README_JA ('はじめかた' step 4 and '困ったときは > マウスで視点が動かない') and README.md:154 promise two things that do not work in the current build, because of the A-level mouse issue: clicking the game screen re-captures the mouse, and an automatic hold-and-drag look fallback.
issues.repro: See the A-level mouse issue: clicking the screen and drag-look were executed and did nothing.
issues.fix: No text change is needed once the CSS fix lands. Re-run probe2-style checks after the fix and keep the wording.

issues.problem: There is no on-screen indication when the mouse is not captured, or when drag-look mode is active. input.js reports drag-look only via console.warn, which a zero-knowledge user never sees.
issues.repro: Code-verified: the only consumers of pointerLocked/dragLook are input.js and engine.js. No HUD element references them.
issues.fix: Show a small HUD chip 'CLICK TO AIM / クリックで照準' (not locked) or 'DRAG TO AIM / ドラッグで照準' (dragLook) while playing.

issues.problem: If the boss dies first and the player dies in the same step, results show MISSION COMPLETE, rank S and 'AP REMAINING 10,000' while the rig is exploding on screen.
issues.repro: Executed (edge.mjs): stage(2) -> wait for the fight -> killAll('boss') then damagePlayer(999999) in the same step -> results: COMPLETE, S, apRemaining 10000. The other order gives MISSION FAILED. Both are consistent and nothing crashes.
issues.fix: Optional polish: recompute apRemaining in finalResult from the live player when the mission:end event fires (it would read 0), or treat a player death inside the outro as 'complete, rig lost'.

issues.problem: In portrait or tiny windows (405x720, 320x240) the HUD scales down until its text is unreadable. At 32:9 the fixed vertical FOV of 50 gives a very wide horizontal FOV. Canvas size and camera aspect follow every resize correctly, with no errors.
issues.fix: Low priority (PC keyboard/mouse game). Clamp the --u HUD scale to a minimum readable size, and cap horizontal FOV around 120 degrees for aspect ratios above 21:9.

issues.problem: The smoke real-time row only checks state changes. It would pass with mouse aim and fire completely dead (it passed on this build). Its 'aimYaw 1.68' value is the spawn yaw, not evidence that mouse look works.
issues.repro: Both smoke runs PASSED while probe.mjs shows canvas mousedown = 0.
issues.fix: In the real-time check, assert elementFromPoint(centre) is the canvas after LAUNCH, that aimYaw changes by more than 0.05 after a drag, and that weapon:fired from the player increases after a mouse down.

issues.problem: 62 of 114 arena kit meshes and 20 of 64 unique arena meshes have no UV channel. M_IW_Arena is vertex-colour only, so this is fine for shading, but Unreal's lightmap UV generation and some import options may warn or fail. Not testable here.

qa_round1.summary:
I followed the Fable gamedev review protocol (phases 0–3) on the current dist/ironwake.html build of 08:34; no source file has changed since. Verdict: FIX_REQUIRED. There are 2 A defects and no S. Everything below was executed in headless Chromium (SwiftShader).

What passed:
- npm run check passes, and npm run smoke passes on both the dev server and dist.
- A real-input game played from file:// with no TEST API works: title -> briefing -> mission, every control, 62 s of free play, death -> results -> retry, win -> results -> retry, 5 restart clicks.
- The mission state machine holds up under every edge case tried: boss killed during its intro, same-frame deaths, pause during transitions, restart during the boss cinematic.
- QB spam at 0 EN, assault/quick boost into thin walls (no tunnelling), the camera never inside geometry, and lock-on target death all behave.
- The sim is identical across render cadences, and there is no Math.random/Date.now in the sim.
- An 11 min session and repeated restarts show no leaks.

Defects:
- A1 (mouse): css/main.css line 21 gives the hidden full-screen #menus layer pointer-events:auto, so without pointer lock every click lands on it instead of the canvas. Mouse fire, click-to-recapture and the drag-look fallback are all dead (probe evidence; an injected CSS fix restores them). In real Chrome this most likely happens after pausing with Esc and resuming with Esc — not reproducible headless.
- A2 (packaging): the playable dist/ironwake.html is gitignored and was never committed. It must be force-added at release.

There are 11 B items. The main ones:
- Keys pressed in the pause menu fire on resume and can waste a repair kit; a one-line latch clear fixes it.
- The OPTIONS quality setting only changes post-effects.
- No auto-pause when the window loses focus while the mouse is not captured.
- No gamepad menu navigation.
- Slow motion below 12 fps.
- The README's mouse-capture and drag-look promises fail until A1 is fixed.
- No on-screen hint when the mouse is not captured.
- The smoke test cannot catch A1.
- Minor results, aspect-ratio and UE5-UV polish.

Not verifiable here: frame rate on a real GPU, audio by ear, Chrome's real pointer-lock policy, a real gamepad, the UE5 import.
